name: speccode
description: Multi-requirement parallel development, in-repo spec hosting, standardized PR flow, and SDD methodology (explore / document / plan / subagent execution / review) — a process orchestration plugin.
_note: ZCode adapter follows the Kimi Code manifest shape (user-confirmed assumption). 待验证: manifest schema, field names and install command have NOT been verified against official ZCode docs — verify before release.
skillInstructions:
Speccode tool mapping for ZCode (待验证 — tool names below assume Kimi-Code-compatible semantics; verify against official ZCode docs):
- When a speccode skill says to ask the user (one question at a time, presenting concrete options), call ZCode's structured question tool if it provides one; otherwise ask in plain text, one question at a time.
- When a speccode skill says to dispatch a subagent, use ZCode's agent/subagent mechanism (待验证 tool name). Speccode skills that depend on subagents declare a fallback route — follow it when no subagent mechanism is available.
- Speccode engine calls are written as `speccode <verb> --cwd .`. Ensure the engine shim is on PATH first: run `bash scripts/install-shim.sh` from the plugin root once. If the shim is missing, call `node <plugin-root>/bin/speccode.mjs <verb> --cwd .` instead (plugin root = the directory containing this manifest).
- Use ZCode's file/shell/search tools by their actual exposed names.
- For in-plugin reference files, resolve the plugin root via `speccode plugin-root --cwd .` rather than hardcoding paths.
